offering_description.value: Builds and maintains highways, bridges, water and other public infrastructure, and produces aggregates, asphalt and concrete materials. Customers are mainly public agencies, and work is delivered through bid-based construction contracts and its own quarries and plants.

primary_services.value: heavy civil construction; highway and bridge construction; water infrastructure construction; construction management; pavement maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, counties, cities, water districts; B2B: private developers, commercial and industrial project owners

end_markets.value: transportation infrastructure; water infrastructure; commercial and private development; mining

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and unit-price construction contracts for infrastructure projects; product sales: aggregates, asphalt and concrete sold to contractors and project owners

value_chain_position.value: service provider: builds infrastructure projects for public and private owners under contract; raw materials: produces aggregates from owned quarries, sold to construction customers; OEM / manufacturer: makes asphalt and ready-mix concrete at its own plants for projects
value_chain_position.category: service provider; raw materials; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: US national: Operations across many US states, concentrated in California, Nevada, Colorado, Texas and other western and southern states

specialization.value: related lines: construction services and construction materials, sharing public infrastructure customers and project sites

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and contracts won directly with public agencies and private owners; own locations: quarries, asphalt and concrete plants supplying its own and outside projects

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental permits for quarries and plants, safety rules, and public contracting and prevailing wage requirements
